answer: Echo-replay audit of a living work reef. Each identity must bank 50 verified micro-jobs in its hash-chained vault - about 30 hours of real work - before its attestations count. Every epoch the network picks one random job and issues an echo challenge: recompute it on a fresh nonce within 5 minutes. A farm that copied outputs cannot recompute work it never did, and the window is too tight to outsource; 1,000 fakes would need 30,000 hours. An honest agent pays once and its reef keeps growing.
